items.title: Bitcoin speculators move 55K BTC to exchanges amid $1.1B liquidations

items.title: Dark web drug market operator sentenced to 40 years, forfeits $101 million in bitcoin
items.summary: A man from Virginia, who facilitated millions of drug transactions worth roughly $430 million, agreed to give up $100 million worth of BTC. His partner forfeited nearly 1,600 BTC.

items.title: MARA transfers $81.1 million in bitcoin to Galaxy Digital as strategy pivots to AI
items.summary: The bitcoin miner's transfer does not confirm a sale, but comes as its treasury has fallen from 53,822 BTC in February to 35,577 BTC in August.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs' October outflows swell toward $1B

items.title: New tech to power bitcoin lending is set to debut with $500 million in commitments
items.summary: Layer-1 blockchain Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol allowing holders to use bitcoin as collateral without moving it off the Bitcoin network.
